papers.title: Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
papers.abstract: Foundation models pretrained on large natural-image collections are increasingly adapted for medical image segmentation, in the expectation that they will replace models trained for each task. Most comparisons, however, use data from the training distribution and a single task-specific baseline whose configuration is rarely justified, and therefore provide limited evidence of performance at new clinical sites. It also remains unclear how much of a foundation model must be adapted, and what determines this. We adapted a foundation model, DINOv2, with strategies ranging from tuning only its bias terms to full fine-tuning, and compared it with U-Nets and ResU-Nets trained from scratch. Experiments covered colonoscopy, breast ultrasound and dermoscopy, with testing on held-out data from the training source and on independent datasets from other institutions. The adapted foundation model generalised better on every external dataset. Within the training distribution, the task-specific models remained competitive when training data were abundant, and delineated boundaries more precisely, while the foundation model more often missed small lesions. Only a small fraction of the foundation model required adaptation, and the capacity needed was determined by the imaging domain rather than by the adaptation method. A widely used polyp test set was also found to duplicate images from another benchmark. Foundation-model adaptation is therefore warranted where models must work across sites, with capacity selected on the target domain.
papers.summary_zh: 在自然图像上预训练的基础模型正被用于医学图像分割，但现有比较多局限于训练分布内且基线配置缺乏依据，难以证明其在新临床站点的表现，也不清楚需要适配多少模型容量。该研究以DINOv2为基础模型，采用从仅调偏置项到全微调的多种策略，与从头训练的U-Net和ResU-Net在结肠镜、乳腺超声和皮肤镜数据上比较，并在训练来源的留出数据及其他机构独立数据集上测试。结果显示适配后的基础模型在所有外部数据集上泛化更好，训练分布内数据充足时任务专用模型仍具竞争力且边界更精确，而基础模型更易漏检小病灶；仅需适配极小部分参数，所需容量由成像域而非适配方法决定，且发现常用息肉测试集与其他基准存在图像重复，表明跨站点应用宜采用基础模型适配并按目标域选择容量。
papers.summary_en: Foundation models pretrained on natural images are increasingly adapted for medical image segmentation, yet most comparisons use in-distribution data and a single unjustified task-specific baseline, giving limited evidence of performance at new clinical sites and leaving unclear how much adaptation is needed. This study adapted DINOv2 with strategies from bias-only tuning to full fine-tuning and compared it with from-scratch U-Nets and ResU-Nets across colonoscopy, breast ultrasound and dermoscopy, testing on held-out in-distribution data and independent external datasets. The adapted foundation model generalised better on every external dataset, task-specific models remained competitive with precise boundaries when in-distribution data were abundant while the foundation model more often missed small lesions, only a small fraction of the model required adaptation with capacity determined by imaging domain rather than adaptation method, and a widely used polyp test set was found to duplicate images from another benchmark, supporting foundation-model adaptation for cross-site use with capacity chosen on the target domain.
highlights_zh: 系统比较基础模型适配与任务专用训练
外部数据集上适配模型全面占优
跨站点宜适配，容量按目标域选

papers.title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
papers.abstract: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated datasets. In medical lesion detection, the scarcity of comprehensive, stan dardized annotations and the heterogeneity of existing datasets limit the development of robust foundation models. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to building a multi-domain foundation model for le sion detection by integrating diverse medical image datasets annotated for both anatomical structures and abnormalities. We first propose a student-teacher training strategy to effectively combine datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and im proving feature learning. In addition, building on our previously pro posed example-based EM-DETR framework, we adapt it to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets, enabling fine-grained, example driven detection across modalities. Our model achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, with image-level AUC scores exceeding previous SOTA by 1% point on four key findings in CXRs. We achieve a leading mAP50 in CXRs and mammography, surpassing EM-DETR trained on a single dataset by 2-3% points. This approach paves the way for scalable foundation models in medical imaging that leverage heterogeneous data while maintaining robust and generalizable performance.
papers.summary_zh: 医学病灶检测缺乏大规模标准化标注，现有数据集异质性强，限制了鲁棒基础模型的发展。本文整合多域医学图像数据集，提出学生-教师训练策略以融合异质标签空间并缓解灾难性遗忘，同时将基于示例的EM-DETR框架扩展为多数据集联合学习。模型在胸片四项关键发现上图像级AUC超此前SOTA 1个百分点，胸片与乳腺摄影mAP50领先单数据集EM-DETR 2-3个百分点，为可扩展医学影像基础模型提供了路径。
papers.summary_en: Medical lesion detection lacks large, standardized annotations and existing datasets are heterogeneous, limiting robust foundation models. This work integrates multi-domain medical image datasets, proposes a student-teacher training strategy to combine heterogeneous label spaces while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and extends the example-based EM-DETR framework to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets. The model exceeds prior SOTA by 1 AUC point on four key CXR findings and leads mAP50 in CXR and mammography by 2-3 points over single-dataset EM-DETR, paving the way for scalable medical imaging foundation models.
highlights_zh: 学生-教师策略融合异质标签空间
胸片AUC超SOTA 1个百分点
可扩展医学基础模型新路径

papers.title: TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
papers.abstract: We present TorchCurves, a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives. Its central operation maps batches of scalar inputs to points on curves represented in B-spline or Legendre polynomial bases, with differentiation through both inputs and coefficients. Curve coefficients can be optimized jointly with the surrounding model or produced by another network. The library provides trainable modules, reusable basis modules, and a functional interface, supporting applications ranging from continuous feature embeddings to Kolmogorov-Arnold networks and functional regression. Its implementation combines classical evaluation algorithms with vectorized PyTorch operations, emphasizing readability and maintainability without custom hardware kernels. Timing experiments compare curve evaluation against NumPy and SciPy and KAN training against EfficientKAN across a range of problem sizes. The results illustrate where this generality remains computationally practical and where overhead is substantial. Library is available on GitHub at https://github.com/alexshtf/torchcurves.
papers.summary_zh: 现有深度学习框架缺乏将向量值参数曲线作为可学习原语的原生支持。TorchCurves 是一个 PyTorch 库，通过 B 样条或 Legendre 多项式基将批量标量输入映射为曲线上的点，并支持对输入和系数同时求导，提供可训练模块、可复用基模块和函数式接口。计时实验对比了曲线求值与 NumPy/SciPy 以及 KAN 训练与 EfficientKAN 的表现，揭示了该通用方法在何种规模下仍具计算实用性、何时开销显著。
papers.summary_en: Existing deep learning frameworks lack native support for treating vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives. TorchCurves is a PyTorch library that maps batches of scalar inputs to points on curves represented in B-spline or Legendre polynomial bases, with differentiation through both inputs and coefficients, offering trainable modules, reusable basis modules, and a functional interface. Timing experiments compare curve evaluation against NumPy/SciPy and KAN training against EfficientKAN across problem sizes, illustrating where this generality remains computationally practical and where overhead is substantial.
highlights_zh: 曲线作为可学习原语，输入与系数均可微
给出与NumPy/SciPy及EfficientKAN的计时对比
适用于连续特征嵌入与KAN，但存在开销
highlights_en: Curves as learnable primitives, differentiable in inputs and coefficients
Timing comparisons vs NumPy/SciPy and EfficientKAN
Useful for continuous embeddings and KANs, with notable overhead

papers.title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all four domains, with gains of 7.2 points in ALFWorld success and 4.0 points in average QA exact match. On GPU kernel generation, AutoScaffold increases the fraction of tasks with a correct kernel that runs faster than the PyTorch reference by up to 5.0 points. On math, our student surpasses QuestA's reported accuracy using approximately one-third as many student training steps. Analyses show that the teacher identifies a different failure in each task class and shifts its scaffolds from step-by-step workflows to targeted fixes as the student improves, and that its revised scaffolds help the student learn more than keeping the previous scaffold or using no scaffold.
papers.summary_zh: RLVR训练中结果奖励把每次尝试压缩为单一数值，大量训练经验信息未被利用，而训练时脚手架的设计与适配主要依赖人工且针对特定领域。AutoScaffold提出统一的AI-for-AI框架，用冻结教师周期性检查学生训练经验、诊断瓶颈，并生成跨任务共享策略与单任务提示两类脚手架，随学生进步动态调整内容与支持量，评估时移除脚手架。在ALFWorld、搜索式QA、数学推理和GPU内核生成四个领域，无脚手架评估下学生均优于对应RL基线，ALFWorld成功率提升7.2点、QA平均精确匹配提升4.0点，GPU内核生成最多提升5.0点，数学上用约三分之一训练步数超过QuestA报告精度，表明训练经验可被自动转化为自适应指导。
papers.summary_en: In RLVR, outcome rewards collapse each attempt into a single number, leaving most training experience unused, while training-time scaffolds are largely hand-designed and domain-specific. AutoScaffold introduces a unified AI-for-AI framework in which a frozen teacher periodically inspects the student's experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs both class-shared strategies and per-task hints, adapting content and support as the student improves, with scaffolds removed at evaluation. Across ALFWorld, search-based QA, math reasoning, and GPU kernel generation, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform corresponding RL baselines without scaffolds, gaining 7.2 points in ALFWorld success, 4.0 points in average QA exact match, up to 5.0 points on GPU kernels, and surpassing QuestA's reported math accuracy with about one-third of the training steps, showing that training experience can be automatically converted into adaptive guidance.
highlights_zh: 冻结教师自动诊断并生成自适应脚手架
四领域均超RL基线，最高提升7.2点
减少人工设计，评估时无需脚手架

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Needs a Logic of Inference
papers.abstract: Neural networks are increasingly studied not merely as predictive systems, but as complex systems whose internal computations are themselves objects of scientific inquiry. Recent progress in mechanistic interpretability (MI) has made it possible to identify neurons, features, circuits, population structures, and dynamical patterns associated with model behavior. As these tools improve, attention is shifting from what can be observed inside a model to how those observations support mechanistic explanations. We examine the parallel efforts of neuroscience and MI to address this question and identify recurring inferential bottlenecks when inferring mechanisms from complex neural systems. We propose five principles and organize them into a recursive logic for a more rigorous procedure of mechanistic inference. These principles provide a framework that supports scientific discovery in two senses: it helps turn local interpretability findings into cumulative knowledge of mechanisms within models, and it makes those mechanisms sufficiently precise to generate testable hypotheses about domains beyond the models. Evidence beyond MI is ultimately required to establish what model mechanisms reveal about the world.
papers.summary_zh: 机制可解释性（MI）研究正从识别模型内部结构转向如何用这些观察支撑机理解释，但缺乏严谨的推理逻辑。作者借鉴神经科学的经验，识别出从复杂神经系统中推断机制的反复出现的推理瓶颈，并提出五项原则组成递归推理逻辑。该框架有助于将局部可解释性发现累积为模型机制的可靠知识，并生成可检验的假设，但最终仍需MI之外的证据来确立机制对世界的意义。
papers.summary_en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) is shifting from identifying internal structures to justifying how observations support mechanistic explanations, yet it lacks a rigorous inferential logic. Drawing on parallels with neuroscience, the authors identify recurring inferential bottlenecks in inferring mechanisms from complex neural systems and propose five principles organized into a recursive logic for mechanistic inference. This framework helps turn local interpretability findings into cumulative mechanistic knowledge and precise, testable hypotheses, though evidence beyond MI is ultimately needed to establish what model mechanisms reveal about the world.
highlights_zh: 提出五项原则构成递归推理逻辑
无实验数据，属方法论框架
助累积知识并生成可检验假设
highlights_en: Five principles forming a recursive inference logic
Enables cumulative knowledge and testable hypotheses

papers.title: Measuring Robustness and Efficiency in a Connectome-Constrained Fly Visual System Model: Linking an Adversarial and a Perceptual Illusion
papers.abstract: Biological visual systems compute reliably under tight metabolic and wiring constraints, whereas artificial vision systems consume far more energy and can be sensitive to adversarial perturbations. Whether networks with brain-like wiring are more robust at lower computational cost is unclear. We address this by benchmarking a task-optimized, continuous-time recurrent neural network of the fly visual system constrained by its synaptic connectome (FlyNet) against artificial neural networks. We compare it against CNNs, RAFT, and continuous-time recurrent neural networks without detailed connectome constraints (sCTRNN, CTRNN) on a collision-detection task within a differentiable 3D rendering pipeline. FlyNet is adversarially vulnerable but, relative to its compute, more robust to common video corruptions than RAFT, while using up to five orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs. The CTRNNs remain more robust than FlyNet across almost all tested perturbations, suggesting that connectome constraints benefit efficiency, through their low edge count, over robustness. Recurrence improves robustness to white-box attacks in RAFT and temporal context improves robustness to common corruptions. FlyNet's position and velocity representations degrade under adversarial textures but recover under counterfactual textures that restore correct classification while staying equally far from training, ruling out unfamiliar textures as the cause of failure. The reverse-phi illusion similarly disrupts these representations and inverts the same low-level motion statistic as the adversarial textures. Optimizing this input statistic alone, without access to the network, suffices to induce classification failure, attributing both perturbations to the same circuit vulnerability. Connectome-constrained models can thus surface adversarial failure mechanisms as testable hypotheses about biological perceptual vulnerabilities.
papers.summary_zh: 生物视觉系统在代谢和布线约束下仍能可靠计算，而人工视觉系统能耗高且易受对抗扰动影响，但类脑布线网络是否更鲁棒且低耗尚不明确。该研究在可微3D渲染的碰撞检测任务上，将受突触连接组约束的果蝇视觉系统连续时间循环网络（FlyNet）与CNN、RAFT及无连接组约束的循环网络进行基准对比。结果显示FlyNet虽易受对抗攻击，但相对其计算量对常见视频损坏比RAFT更鲁棒且FLOPs少达五个数量级，而连接组约束主要提升效率而非鲁棒性，并揭示对抗纹理与反向phi错觉共享同一低级运动统计量漏洞。
papers.summary_en: Biological visual systems compute reliably under metabolic and wiring constraints, whereas artificial vision systems are energy-hungry and vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, leaving unclear whether brain-like wiring yields robustness at lower cost. This work benchmarks a connectome-constrained continuous-time recurrent network of the fly visual system (FlyNet) against CNNs, RAFT, and unconstrained recurrent networks on a collision-detection task in a differentiable 3D rendering pipeline. FlyNet is adversarially vulnerable but more robust to common video corruptions than RAFT relative to its compute (up to five orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs), with connectome constraints benefiting efficiency over robustness, and both adversarial textures and the reverse-phi illusion are traced to the same low-level motion statistic vulnerability.
highlights_zh: 连接组约束网络与人工网络多维度基准对比
相对计算量更鲁棒且FLOPs少五个数量级
揭示对抗与错觉共享电路漏洞可作生物假设

papers.title: RS-JEPA: Remote Sensing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with Scan-Path Views for Cross-Sensor Image Retrieval
papers.abstract: Cross-sensor remote sensing image retrieval aims to find scenes with the same content across heterogeneous sensors, such as SAR and optical or panchromatic (PAN) and multispectral (MS) imagery, without manual labels. Existing self-supervised methods either reconstruct sensor-specific pixel detail, align each image only with its co-registered twin, or rely on large transformers with 118-173M parameters (and up to 398M). We introduce RS-JEPA, a compact joint-embedding predictive framework built on a Vision Mamba encoder shared by both sensors. Since a state-space encoder reads an image as an ordered sequence of patches, we propose scan-path views, which treat two reading orders of the same image as two views with identical pixels and predict the hidden patches in one order from the visible patches in the other.To keep this prediction challenging, we propose Adversarial View Coupling (AVC), which learns the hardest split of the visible patches, and a neighbourhood consensus loss that aligns the scene similarities of both sensors. Extensive experiments on SAR-optical (BEN-14K, CBRSIR-VS) and PAN-MS (DSRSID) benchmarks demonstrate that RS-JEPA achieves the highest F1@5 among twelve re-implemented methods (72.92, 80.35 and 94.43) with a retrieval network of only 3.88M parameters (14.57M in training, 8-16times fewer than prior JEPA retrievers). Like prior methods, RS-JEPA trains on co-registered pairs. Our results highlight reading order as a source of self-supervised views. code: https://github.com/Tanishq251/RSJEPA.
papers.summary_zh: 跨传感器遥感图像检索需在无标签条件下匹配SAR与光学或全色与多光谱等异源图像，现有自监督方法或重建像素细节、或仅对齐配准图像对、或依赖118-398M参数的大模型。本文提出RS-JEPA，基于共享Vision Mamba编码器构建紧凑联合嵌入预测框架，利用状态空间编码器按序读取图像的特性提出扫描路径视图（同一图像两种读取顺序互为视图），并引入对抗视图耦合学习最难可见块划分及邻域一致性损失对齐两传感器场景相似度。在SAR-光学与全色-多光谱三个基准上，RS-JEPA以仅3.88M参数（训练14.57M，比先前JEPA检索器少8-16倍）取得十二种复现方法中最高的F1@5（72.92、80.35、94.43），揭示读取顺序可作为自监督视图来源。
papers.summary_en: Cross-sensor remote sensing image retrieval aims to match scenes across heterogeneous sensors such as SAR-optical or PAN-MS without labels, but existing self-supervised methods either reconstruct sensor-specific pixels, align only co-registered pairs, or rely on large 118-398M-parameter transformers. We introduce RS-JEPA, a compact joint-embedding predictive framework built on a shared Vision Mamba encoder, which exploits the sequential patch reading of state-space models via scan-path views (two reading orders of the same image as two views) and keeps prediction challenging with Adversarial View Coupling and a neighbourhood consensus loss aligning scene similarities across sensors. On SAR-optical (BEN-14K, CBRSIR-VS) and PAN-MS (DSRSID) benchmarks, RS-JEPA achieves the highest F1@5 among twelve re-implemented methods (72.92, 80.35, 94.43) with only 3.88M retrieval parameters (14.57M in training, 8-16x fewer than prior JEPA retrievers), highlighting reading order as a source of self-supervised views.
highlights_zh: 扫描路径视图：读取顺序作自监督视图
仍需配准图像对训练，泛化受限

papers.title: Is Your Robot's Memory Just a Clock? Temporal Shortcuts in Memory-Augmented VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Memory-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies are meant to remember what happened. Many of them, however, fill memory by time: they sample frames uniformly across the episode and stamp each frame with its time step. Because time passes even when nothing happens, such a memory may not tell waiting from working. We show that it does not. On the counting tasks of RoboMME, we make the robot briefly pause or fidget its wrist. Such a null event changes nothing the task depends on, yet a released memory VLA counts the interval as work done and stops early. We call this failure phantom progress. It cuts success from 47 to 16 of 50 on one task and from 44 to 10 on the other. When the same frames are withheld from memory, success returns, so the cause lies in memory rather than in the interruption itself. We trace the failure to a temporal shortcut: because demonstrations proceed at a steady pace, elapsed time predicts progress. Indeed, rescaling the time stamps alone makes the policy stop early when the clock runs fast and repeat when it runs slow. Surprisingly, removing the time encoding does not cure the failure, because the frames of a null event still occupy slots of the time-sampled memory. Across RoboMME's released designs, vulnerability follows how memory is indexed. Of the fixes the diagnosis suggests, training with injected pauses does not remove the failure and impairs counting, whereas indexing memory by events recovers half or more of the loss without retraining. A memory meant to remember what happened should count events rather than clock ticks.
papers.summary_zh: 记忆增强VLA策略通常按时间均匀采样帧并打上时间戳来填充记忆，但时间流逝不等于任务进展，导致机器人把空事件误判为已完成的工作。作者通过在RoboMME计数任务中注入短暂停顿或手腕抖动等空事件，揭示出“幻影进展”失败模式，并将其归因于时间捷径——演示节奏稳定使经过时间可预测进度。实验显示该失败使成功率从47/50降至16/50、从44/10降至10/50，而去除时间编码无效，按事件索引记忆可在不重训的情况下挽回至少一半损失，表明记忆应计数事件而非时钟滴答。
papers.summary_en: Memory-augmented VLA policies typically fill memory by sampling frames uniformly over time and stamping them with time steps, but elapsed time does not equal task progress, so the robot may confuse waiting with working. By injecting null events such as brief pauses or wrist fidgeting into RoboMME counting tasks, the authors expose a failure mode called phantom progress and trace it to a temporal shortcut: steady demonstration pacing makes elapsed time predictive of progress. The failure cuts success from 47 to 16 of 50 on one task and from 44 to 10 on another, removing time encoding does not help, and event-based memory indexing recovers at least half the loss without retraining, showing that memory should count events rather than clock ticks.
highlights_zh: 揭示时间捷径导致的幻影进展失败
按事件索引记忆可免重训挽回损失

papers.title: TanCRAFT: Context-Reasoned Anticipatory Feedback for Assembly Tasks
papers.abstract: Preventing human error in physical assembly tasks requires assistance systems that can intervene before mistakes are made. This is especially challenging in settings where users are free to choose the construction order and correctness depends on the evolving assembly rather than a fixed next step. We present TanCRAFT, a four-stage real-time predictive assistance system that tracks the scene state, reasons about the current partial assembly, forecasts the near-future motion of manipulated pieces, and intervenes when the predicted placement is incompatible with the target. We instantiate our framework and confirm its effectiveness in a controlled tangram assembly task through offline benchmarks and a within-subject user study. Our findings show that the predictive feedback significantly reduces mistakes relative to unguided and reactive sessions, while yielding the lowest mean perceived workload and shortest mean completion time. Overall, these results demonstrate the value of predictive feedback for error prevention and provide a step toward cost-aware assistance for automation and human-robot workcells.
papers.summary_zh: 在物理装配任务中，用户可自由选择装配顺序且正确性取决于动态装配状态，传统系统难以在错误发生前干预。TanCRAFT提出四阶段实时预测辅助系统：跟踪场景状态、推理当前部分装配、预测操作件的近期运动，并在预测放置与目标不兼容时干预。在七巧板装配实验中，预测反馈相比无引导和反应式会话显著减少错误，同时感知工作负荷最低、平均完成时间最短，展示了预测反馈在错误预防中的价值。
papers.summary_en: In physical assembly tasks where users freely choose construction order and correctness depends on the evolving assembly, preventing errors before they occur is challenging. TanCRAFT presents a four-stage real-time predictive assistance system that tracks scene state, reasons about the current partial assembly, forecasts near-future motion of manipulated pieces, and intervenes when the predicted placement is incompatible with the target. In a controlled tangram assembly study, predictive feedback significantly reduced mistakes compared to unguided and reactive sessions while yielding the lowest perceived workload and shortest completion time, demonstrating the value of predictive feedback for error prevention.
highlights_zh: 四阶段实时预测辅助框架
错误显著减少且完成时间最短
面向人机协作的预测式防错
highlights_en: Significantly fewer errors and shortest completion time
Predictive error prevention for human-robot workcells

papers.title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.

papers.summary_en: LLM agents for open-ended scientific discovery typically evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing a claim only against its negation, so rejecting a hypothesis does not reveal which alternative the evidence supports. Contrastive Discovery replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set of mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations, scoring experiments by how they redistribute belief across the set and resolving the question when belief concentrates on one explanation. Across six domains, 89% of pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts were rejections, contrast sets resolved 73% of these to a specific alternative, guided search resolved 67% more questions under the same experiment budget, and human experts agreed on 78% of resolved questions, supporting explicit competing explanations as a way to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.
